source: Author requested six additional Cultural objects, October 15, 2026. These are new local game brainstorming proposals checked against the current catalog and Docs/WORLD_BASIS.md. No custom, named culture, institution, song, faith or source-world canon is established by their addition.
boundary: Catalog objects only. No new faction, quest, ritual benefit, trade price, recipe, performance system, world placement, streaming, generated identity or persisted gameplay delta. No wood, ordinary cloth, plant materials or natural free water assumed.

defaults.Carrier metadata: Physical keepsake, performance prop or leisure object; packing, mass and carrying limits unresolved.
defaults.Acquisition: Proposed artisan work, personal exchange or settlement trade; availability and ownership customs remain undefined.
defaults.Crafting / processing: Candidate finished object using selected prepared stock. No quantities, production time, yield or executable recipe authored.
defaults.Limitations: Material preparation, construction, cultural meaning, value and use remain proposals. No automatic social standing, knowledge unlock, supernatural effect or gameplay bonus.
defaults.Classification basis: Author-requested cultural-object expansion. Distinct finished objects for proposed leisure, storytelling and craft expression; no existing cultural practice is asserted as canon.
defaults.Tier basis: Proposed T2 finished object using qualified T1 stock. Material preparation, design, construction and useful performance remain unresolved.

items.name: Engraved shell game tiles
items.purpose: A small matched group of shell tiles with contrasting incised marks, proposed for a portable counting or strategy game during rest stops. The tiles are play pieces rather than currency, devotional offerings or a record of rank; rules and imagery remain to be designed.
items.icon: Six small polished shell rectangles with distinct deeply cut geometric marks, arranged beside a short stack.

fields.Search aliases: shell game tiles; portable strategy pieces; engraved play tiles
fields.Limitations: No game rules, gambling economy, common symbolism or accepted regional tradition established. The listed item is the matched tile group, without an extra bag, board or storage case.

items.name: Ceramic storytelling mask
items.purpose: A stylized ceramic face held or supported during a proposed dramatic retelling. Its exaggerated brow and mouth distinguish a performed character rather than a named ancestor, deity or official role.
items.icon: A hollow ochre ceramic face with an exaggerated brow, open eye slots and a plain metal holding loop at one side.

fields.Search aliases: story mask; ceramic performance mask; dramatic face prop
fields.Limitations: A performance prop, not protective armor, respiratory equipment or a new wearable slot. Visibility, holding method, character conventions and cultural acceptance remain proposals.

items.name: Jointed shell shadow figure
items.purpose: A thin articulated shell cutout with metal pivot pins, proposed for manually showing silhouettes while telling stories. A suitable local light and projection surface would be required; neither an electrical display nor automatic animation is supplied.
items.icon: A flat beetle-like shell silhouette with three movable limbs, tiny metal pivot pins and a short all-metal operating stem.

fields.Search aliases: shell shadow puppet; articulated storytelling silhouette; jointed performance figure
fields.Limitations: No wood, cloth screen, ordinary flame, powerful glow-stone projection or working performance system assumed. Figure identity, usable illumination and storytelling customs remain open.

items.name: Husk-paper songbook
items.purpose: A small folio of prepared husk-paper leaves proposed to preserve song words, repeated lines or simple performance marks. It records a repertoire rather than tuning an instrument, claiming a civic office or supplying a devotional text.
items.icon: A slim stack of pale husk-paper leaves between thin shell covers, joined by small metal rings and marked with short repeated lines.

fields.Tier basis: Proposed T3 assembled folio using the existing T2 husk-paper material with prepared covers and metal binding parts. Writing, notation and manufacture remain proposals.
fields.Search aliases: song folio; husk-paper songbook; travelers repertoire
fields.Limitations: No actual lyrics, standard musical notation, literacy level, common language, universal tradition or knowledge unlock established. Covers and binding use shell and metal, not wood or cloth.

items.name: Apprentice practice plaque
items.purpose: A ceramic plaque bearing successive incised practice patterns and correction marks, proposed as a personal record of learning a craft. It shows unfinished attempts rather than the accomplished work displayed by the existing guild craft exemplar.
items.icon: A small fired ceramic tablet with several rows of increasingly regular carved motifs and a few crossed-out attempts.

fields.Search aliases: craft practice tablet; apprentice exercise plaque; learning keepsake
fields.Limitations: Does not establish a guild membership system, formal apprenticeship institution, qualification, skill increase or crafting unlock. Marking methods, ownership and meaning remain proposals.

items.name: Household pattern roller
items.purpose: A small engraved ceramic cylinder on a metal axle, proposed for repeating a decorative motif on compatible unfired clay or prepared marking stock. The motif is a personal or household design rather than an official seal, pilgrimage mark or proof of ownership.
items.icon: A palm-sized ceramic roller engraved with a repeating stepped pattern, mounted on a simple bent-metal handle.

fields.Search aliases: decorative pattern roller; household motif cylinder; repeating ceramic stamp
fields.Limitations: Compatible marking media and impression quality require design; no water-based ink, wooden handle or freely available cloth assumed. Motif meanings, inheritance and household customs are unassigned.
